keys.description: Hosted Antigravity (agy) only (unused on other hosts): seconds without a raw ACP session/update during an active model wait, paused while any tool call or approval is pending, before the runner cancels the stalled turn and retries once with continue; a second stall fails the logical turn. The same single retry budget applies when a turn ends on an in-band ⚠ API error chunk. 0 disables. Read at process start for hosted leads and workers.
